北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴天，湿度大。出门带伞，注意防潮哦。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy with high humidity. Carry an umbrella and beware of dampness!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天微热，风力不小，注意防晒防风哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and warm with noticeable wind. Stay protected from sun and wind!
慈溪.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海小雨，体感微凉湿润，出门记得带伞哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai has light rain, feeling cool and damp. Don't forget your umbrella!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴好，体感暖湿。记得补充水分防中暑！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and warm. Stay hydrated to prevent heatstroke!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗炎热，注意防晒，多喝水哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and hot. Stay protected from sun and drink more water!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天闷热，体感 32℃。注意防暑降温！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and muggy, feels like 32℃. Take care to cool down!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天闷热，体感 32℃。多喝水，防中暑。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and muggy, feels like 32℃. Drink water to prevent heatstroke.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都晴热，体感 35℃。无风更闷，记得补水防晒。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is sunny and hot, feels like 35℃. No wind means it's muggy, stay hydrated and use sun protection.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，湿度 100%！体感湿热，注意防潮。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, 100% humidity! It feels muggy and damp, beware of moisture.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云炎热，风力较大。注意防风和补水哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is partly cloudy and hot with strong winds. Be careful with wind and hydrate!
西安.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：西北风 4级

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆晴热，气温 36℃，体感 37℃。注意防暑！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is sunny and extremely hot, 36℃, feels like 37℃. Take care to prevent heatstroke!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云湿润，注意带伞，体感微闷哦。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is partly cloudy and humid. Carry an umbrella, it feels a bit stuffy.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云，湿度 94%。体感湿热，注意防潮防晒。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is partly cloudy, 94% humidity. It feels muggy and hot, beware of dampness and sun.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天凉爽，湿度高。记得添衣，注意防潮哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and cool with high humidity. Remember to add clothes and beware of dampness!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云温暖，风力较大。注意防晒，小心海风。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is partly cloudy and warm with strong winds. Use sun protection and mind the sea breeze.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有雾，湿度 94%。出行注意安全，能见度低。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is foggy, 94% humidity. Travel safely, visibility is low.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴天，风力较大。出门记得添衣防风哦！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy with strong winds. Remember to add clothes and protect from wind!
